# Esquire
> Esquire is a men's lifestyle magazine covering fashion, culture, politics, entertainment, food, drink, and advice.

Esquire.com is the digital home of Esquire, featuring reported journalism, interviews, criticism, style guidance, product recommendations, recipes, and subscription offerings tied to the magazine.

## Main Sections
- [Homepage](https://www.esquire.com/): Front page for Esquire’s latest stories across style, culture, politics, entertainment, and lifestyle.
- [Style](https://www.esquire.com/style/): Men’s fashion, grooming, accessories, watches, and shopping coverage.
- [Entertainment](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/): Celebrity interviews, movie coverage, television, music, and books.
- [News & Politics](https://www.esquire.com/news-politics/): Political reporting, commentary, current events, and opinion.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle/): Health, sex, relationships, travel, gear, and practical advice.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.esquire.com/food-drink/): Recipes, cocktails, restaurant coverage, and drinks journalism.
- [Video](https://www.esquire.com/video/): Video interviews, explainers, and recurring Esquire series.
- [About](https://www.esquire.com/about/a22897/about-us/): Background on Esquire, editorial mission, and brand information.

## Style
- [Men's Fashion](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-fashion/): Clothing trends, outfit advice, seasonal style guides, and shopping recommendations.
- [Grooming](https://www.esquire.com/style/grooming/): Hair, skin, shaving, fragrance, and personal care advice.
- [Men's Accessories](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-accessories/): Watches, bags, wallets, sunglasses, jewelry, and other accessories.
- [What I've Learned](https://www.esquire.com/style/what-ive-learned/): Style-focused interviews and personal lessons from notable figures.
- [Best Products in Style](https://www.esquire.com/style/best-products/): Editor-curated shopping guides and product roundups for menswear and accessories.

## Entertainment
- [Movies](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/movies/): Film news, reviews, features, interviews, and awards coverage.
- [TV](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/tv/): Television recaps, reviews, interviews, and streaming recommendations.
- [Music](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/music/): Music features, artist interviews, album coverage, and criticism.
- [Books](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/books/): Author interviews, reading lists, and literary coverage.
- [Celebrity](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/celebrity/): Profiles, interviews, and celebrity news from film, television, sports, and culture.

## News & Politics
- [Politics](https://www.esquire.com/news-politics/politics/): Coverage of elections, government, policy, and political analysis.
- [Opinion](https://www.esquire.com/news-politics/opinion/): Essays and commentary on politics, media, and public life.
- [News](https://www.esquire.com/news-politics/news/): Breaking developments, reported stories, and current events coverage.
- [The Sidecar](https://www.esquire.com/news-politics/a62875397/the-sidecar-newsletter/): Esquire’s politics-focused newsletter and editorial brief.
- [Best of Esquire Politics](https://www.esquire.com/news-politics/): Main politics hub aggregating recent reporting and commentary.

## Lifestyle
- [Health & Fitness](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle/health-fitness/): Fitness routines, wellness reporting, and health advice.
- [Sex & Relationships](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle/sex/): Dating, intimacy, relationships, and sex advice.
- [Travel](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle/travel/): Destination guides, hotel coverage, and travel recommendations.
- [Gear](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle/best-products/): Product recommendations for tech, home, fitness, and everyday essentials.
- [Best Products](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle/best-products/): Shopping guides and editor-tested picks across lifestyle categories.

## Food & Drink
- [Recipes](https://www.esquire.com/food-drink/food/): Cooking guides, chef features, and recipes for home cooks.
- [Drinks](https://www.esquire.com/food-drink/drinks/): Cocktail recipes, spirits coverage, and bar culture reporting.
- [Cocktails](https://www.esquire.com/food-drink/drinks/how-to/): How-to guides for classic and modern cocktails.
- [Restaurants](https://www.esquire.com/food-drink/restaurants/): Restaurant features, dining recommendations, and chef coverage.
- [Best Bars in America](https://www.esquire.com/food-drink/drinks/g2177/best-bars-america/): Signature Esquire franchise highlighting notable bars around the country.

## Features & Franchises
- [The Big Black Book](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-fashion/advice/g3174/big-black-book-0310/): Esquire’s long-running style franchise focused on menswear essentials and upgrades.
- [What I've Learned](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/interviews/a12198/what-ive-learned/): Interview series collecting life lessons from prominent figures.
- [Explain This](https://www.esquire.com/video/): Video and interview format centered on direct questions and personal insights.
- [Esquire Select](https://www.esquire.com/style/best-products/): Editor-approved product recommendations and shopping coverage.
- [Best Products](https://www.esquire.com/best-products/): Broad hub for shopping guides across style, tech, home, and lifestyle.

## Video & Multimedia
- [Video Hub](https://www.esquire.com/video/): Central destination for Esquire video interviews and original series.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/esquire): Esquire’s official YouTube channel for interviews and recurring video formats.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/esquire/): Social feed featuring editorial highlights, covers, and short-form video.
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@esquire): Short-form video clips from Esquire interviews, style, and culture coverage.

## Newsletters & Subscriptions
- [Newsletter Signup](https://www.esquire.com/email/): Email signup hub for Esquire newsletters and editorial updates.
- [The Sidecar Newsletter](https://www.esquire.com/news-politics/a62875397/the-sidecar-newsletter/): Politics and current events newsletter from Esquire editors.
- [Subscribe](https://subscribe.hearstmags.com/subscribe/splits/esq/esquire_magazine): Magazine subscription page for print and digital access.
- [Customer Service](https://service.esquire.com/): Subscription management, account help, and magazine customer support.
- [Give a Gift](https://subscribe.hearstmags.com/subscribe/splits/esq/esquire_gift): Gift subscription page for Esquire magazine.

## Magazine & Brand Information
- [About Us](https://www.esquire.com/about/a22897/about-us/): Overview of Esquire’s history, mission, and editorial identity.
- [Media Kit](https://www.esquire.com/about/a22898/media-kit/): Advertising and audience information for brand partners.
- [Contact Us](https://www.esquire.com/about/a22899/contact-us/): Contact information for editorial, customer service, and general inquiries.
- [Press Room](https://www.hearst.com/press-room): Hearst corporate press resources relevant to Esquire’s parent company.
- [Hearst](https://www.hearst.com/magazines/esquire): Corporate page for Esquire within Hearst’s magazine portfolio.
